[[File:PolisMassaMedicalBay-CWSW365.png|thumb|right|250px|The medcenter at the [[Polis Massa Research Base]]]]
A '''medcenter''', or '''hospital''', was a location where sick or injured beings were taken to be cured or healed.

Hospitals offered a range of treatment options, including surgery suites, recovery wards, and quarantine units. [[Bacta tank/Legends|Bacta tanks]] were common in medical centers, capable of treating numerous injuries and ailments. Larger facilities had the capabilities to treat patients who needed [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|limb]] and organ replacements.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
